content: Sakiusa weyahina
Ma Yesu Yeliko ꞌoina ꞌiluhu pwaiya, ma ꞌasaina ꞌalonega ꞌitautauya.
Tupwaina ꞌoina ꞌaigeda takesi ꞌadi toꞌewao ꞌadi tohanugeta ꞌimiyamiya, sanina Sakiusa, tauna towasawasa ꞌaigeda.
Ma tutaina Yesu ꞌitautauya, Sakiusa nuwanuwana ma Yesu ꞌida ꞌita ꞌabehega taiya tauna, ma hesi geya sowasowahina ma ꞌiꞌita, weyahina tauna loheya toꞌutoꞌupana, ma wete boda madouna.
Coinega ꞌipili nugeta ta ꞌaiwe ꞌaigeda ꞌihaneya, sanina sikamole, ta nage ꞌoinega Yesu ꞌida ꞌita, ꞌeguma saugaina tupwaina ꞌoina ꞌilatu.
Ma saugaina Yesu ꞌinaoma tupwaina ꞌoina, ꞌiꞌitahaneya ta Sakiusa ꞌiꞌiteya, ꞌoinega ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwae, “Sakiusa, ꞌusuluma mwayamwayau, weyahina nata taugu baꞌidau ꞌino hada tamiyamiya.”
Sakiusa ꞌilomwayamwayauwa ta ꞌisuluwa, ma maꞌina yaliyaya Yesu baꞌidana sihelobaloba.
Nage ꞌoina tomotaedi ginaula bewa siꞌiteya, ma silomugiyeya, sigwaeya, “Togidega ta Yesu ꞌiluhuwa togala ꞌina hada?”

Ma Sakiusaina ꞌitoholowa ta Yesu ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwae, “Bada, bewa ꞌoinega ꞌigu tobwatobwa mabwaiyana yaꞌupwaluwa ma ꞌaigeda tupwa towewelohe yaꞌebwaedi. Ta wete ꞌeguma taiya ꞌoinega mwalo yaꞌewa puiya, yada hemaise maꞌana lohepoi ꞌehata wete yaꞌebwae.”
Coinega Yesu ꞌihegwaeya, “Bewa tuwa hada bewa ꞌoina ꞌabihetena ꞌilatuma, weyahina loheya bewa tauna ꞌaigeda Ebalahamo ꞌina boda.
Taugu Loheyaiguina, ta yanaoma ma ꞌane todeya yaꞌebesedi ma yaꞌabihetedi, gide loheya bewa.”
Gwae hegehegedi heguyai weyahina
Ma Yelusalema deina nata ma silatu, eeta bodaedi sinuwanuwatuhu ꞌabehega Yehoba ꞌina loina nata ꞌihegaina, ꞌoinega gwae hegehegedi bewa ꞌiꞌebwaediya,
ꞌigwaeya, “Caigeda bada ꞌiꞌatububu pwaiya ta ꞌitautauya tupwana bwaga ꞌoina ma ꞌabehega nobwa ꞌihetoloina, ma ꞌabwa muliyetega ꞌilohihilama.

Mulina ma ꞌitauya, ꞌina topaihowao teni ꞌibwau heꞌautedima ma ꞌadi heguheguyai kina ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda ꞌiꞌebwaediya ma ꞌihegwaediya, ‘Cami heguheguyai bewa wahepaihowadi ma ꞌana lohepoi waloba, ꞌana siga yalohihilama.’
“Ma muliyetega badaina ꞌina tomotaiyao tupwadi silogwahateya, geya nuwadi ma ꞌoidiya ꞌihetoloina, ꞌoinega wasa sihesumaneya, sigwaeya, ‘Loheyaina beno geya nuwama ma ꞌoima ꞌihetoloina.’
“Ma badaina tuwa ꞌihetoloina. Eeta tutaina ꞌilohihilama ta ꞌina topaihowaedi ꞌibwau heꞌautedima, nuwanuwana ꞌisanapu ꞌadi heguheguyaiyedi ꞌoidiyega hisa loheposeyana silobediya.
“Ma loheya ꞌaigeda ꞌinugetama ꞌina badaina matana ꞌitoholowa, ma ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwae, ‘Bada, ꞌino kinaina ꞌaigeda mwalo ꞌuꞌebwaegauwa bewa ꞌana lohepoi wete teni yalobediya.’
“Coinega badaina ꞌigwaeya, ‘Causala! Cowa toguibiga moisa, weyahina ginaula ꞌiꞌiuna ma ꞌuhepaihowa bwaibwainiya, ꞌoinega maisau yaꞌebwaego, beno ꞌasa teni ꞌoidiya ꞌuhetoloina.’
“Ma loheya heluwena wete ꞌinaoma ta ꞌigwaeya, ‘Bada, ꞌino kinaina ꞌaigeda mwalo ꞌuꞌebwaegauwa bewa ꞌana lohepoi paibi yalobediya.’
“Coinega tauna wete ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwae, ‘Casa paibi ꞌoidiya ꞌuhetoloina.’
“Ma hetoina wete ꞌinaoma ma ꞌihegwaeya, ‘Bada, ꞌino kinaina bewa ꞌaleꞌo ꞌoinega yawaduya ta yalagu bwaibwainiya.
Weyahina yamatautegowa ꞌamuge ma ꞌiꞌwaiha. Ma moisa, yamatautegowa weyahina ꞌowa loheya paꞌaliu ma ꞌino wasawasa ꞌuꞌewaꞌewa hali tomota ꞌidi paihowa ꞌoidiyega. Coinega ꞌino kina bewa ꞌuꞌewa hila.’

“Ma badaina ꞌigwaeya, ‘Moisa, ꞌowa topaihowa galau. Tuwa ꞌuboi ꞌino gwaeyega ꞌa loina yaꞌebwaego. Weyahina ꞌusanapugauwa ꞌabehega taugu loheya paꞌaligu, ta ꞌigu wasawasa yaꞌewaꞌewa hali tomota ꞌidi paihowa ꞌoidiyega,
ma toꞌaha huhuna ta ꞌoinega geya ꞌigu maneina banika ꞌoina ꞌulagu, ma saugaina yahilama maꞌana lohepoi yaloba?’
“Coinega taudi badaina deina sitotoholo ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwaeya, ‘Cigu kinaina ꞌoinega waꞌewa, ma loheyaina tauna loheposeyana madouna ꞌilobeya waꞌebwae.’
“Ma taudi sigwaeya, ‘Bada, sahena ꞌaꞌebwaꞌebwae, weyahina tauna teni kina ꞌiꞌewediya ta sowasowahina.’

“Ma badaina wete ꞌoidiya ꞌigwaeya, ‘Tuwa waꞌebwae, weyahina ꞌeguma taiya ꞌana heguheguyai ꞌiloheposeyane, ꞌana loheposeyana wete ꞌiloba, ma ꞌeguma taiya geya ꞌiloheposeyane, toꞌaha ꞌoina ꞌimiyamiya ꞌabwa ꞌoinega siꞌewayahule.
Coinega bewa tuwa ꞌagu ꞌalehaowedi, taudi silogwahategauwa ma ꞌabehega geya nuwadi ꞌoidiya yahetoloina, watoedima ma mataguwa waloheꞌamasidi.’”
Yesu ꞌina luhu Yelusalema ꞌoina
Yesu ꞌina gwae bewa ꞌilosalohiya ma ꞌitoholowa, ta maꞌana tomuliyao sihanehane Yelusalema weyahina,
ta ꞌidi tauya ꞌoina Bedipegi ma Bedani deidiya silatulatu, beno Olibe ꞌoyana gabulena, ꞌoinega ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌeluwa ꞌihesumane nugetediya tupwaedi ꞌiꞌiudi ꞌoidiya maꞌadi henuwalagu,
ꞌigwaeya, “Casa nage matamiya ꞌoina watauya, ta nage ꞌoina nata ꞌaigeda hebai waꞌitaloba, beno ꞌase yauyaubona, tauna geya tomota sida gelu tohoya, hebaiina walihasi waꞌeweyama.
Ma ꞌeguma taiya ꞌigwae, ‘Toꞌaha weyahina beno hebaiina walihalihasi?’ loheyaina wahegwae, wagwae, ‘Bada nuwanuwana.’”
Coinega taudi sitauya ta ginaula mabwaiyadi silobediya gide Yesu ꞌihegwae ꞌesediya.
Ma tutaina ꞌaseina silihasiya ma toni hebaiyedi sihegwaediya, sigwaeya, “Togidega ta ꞌima hebai walihalihasi?”
Ta sigwaeya, “Bada nuwanuwana.”
Ma hebaiina siꞌeweya ta sitauyeya Yesu ꞌoina, ma ꞌadi ꞌwamega gwahuna siloyesoya, ꞌoinega Yesu ꞌigeluhaneya,
ta ꞌitautauya ma tomota baibaiwadi ꞌadi ꞌwamao ꞌedai siyesodiya.
Silatulatu Yelusalema deina, ta sidobidobi Olibe ꞌedana ꞌoina, ta ꞌana tomuliyaowedi mabodaidi maꞌidi yaliyaya Yehoba sihehepwatuwe, weyahina ꞌina paihowa waiwaidi siꞌita pwaidiya,
sigwaegwae, “Yauwedo Bada, Yehoba Saninega ꞌutauyama, ꞌoinega yaliyaya ma hepwatu galewa ꞌoina simadou hedada.”
Coinega Palisiyao tupwadi bodaedi ꞌoidiyega Yesu sihegwaeya, sigwaeya, “Bada, ꞌa tomuliyaedi ꞌuhegwaedi ma silolagu.”
Ma Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Sahena yaꞌauꞌausidi, weyahina ꞌeguma taudi silolagu daꞌule ꞌenadi ꞌilagu ma sibwau.”
Yesu ꞌidouwa Yelusalema weyahina
Yesu ꞌilatu pwaiya Yelusalema deina, ma ꞌasaina madouna ꞌiꞌiteya, nuwana ꞌigala ma ꞌidouwa, ꞌigwaeya,
“Yelusalema yo, nata tomotaimwao ꞌatemuyamuyaidi, weyahina tuta bewa ꞌoina ꞌadi ꞌabihetenaina ꞌihapwesama, ma hesi geya sisanapu.
Ma hesi tuta ꞌinaonaoma ꞌoidiya ꞌadi ꞌalehao silatu ma simutudi, weyahina nata ꞌino tupwa mabwaiyana siꞌali sakowasiye,
ma mabwaiyadi siluhu ma tomotaimwao silohegumwalidi, ma wete hada mabwaiyadi sileꞌwa yahuledi. Muyaedi ꞌabwa ꞌoiuwa silatu, weyahina natumwaowedi ꞌadi toꞌabihetenaina geya siꞌinana.”
Yesu togimwaneyao Hada Heꞌasisiyega ꞌipaꞌidiya
Coinega ꞌitauya ta ꞌiluhuwa Hada Heꞌasisi ꞌalona, ma tohegimwane ꞌalonega ꞌipaꞌidiya, ma ꞌihegwaediya,
ꞌigwaeya, “Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌoina Yehoba ꞌina gwae sileleya ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: ‘Cigu hada ꞌabehega hada ꞌebe ꞌahwanoi, ma ꞌomi waꞌabibuiya ta ꞌabehega ꞌimi ꞌebeyagaha.’”

content: Ma sabwelo ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda Hada Heꞌasisiina ꞌoina ꞌiheheꞌita, ma topwaoli madoudi ta loina ꞌana toheꞌitao ma wete tohanugetao sitohotoho ma ꞌabehega Yesu siloheꞌamasi,
ma geya sowasowahidi, weyahina Yesu ꞌina heꞌitao tomota baibaiwadi nuwadi ꞌiꞌeweya.
